_comment: External Bond (Daytona) connection config. Keep this file secure — do not share publicly.
instructions: Poll GET /api/bond/inbox every 3 minutes for directives from IEBC.
After reading directives, post acknowledgment via POST /api/bond/report.
Fetch GET /api/bond/api-snapshot before writing any analysis to get live data.
All requests must include the header: X-Bond-Key: <bond_api_key above>.
Never expose the bond_api_key in logs or reports.
